parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description: Indicates whether the SQL is a template SQL.

parameters.name: FormatSqlId
parameters.description: The ID of the formatted SQL statement.

parameters.name: IsConcurrentLimit
parameters.description:
- Set to `true` to query the throttling information.

- Set to `false` to query the bound index or bound execution plan.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The tenant name. Note: Although this parameter is named TableName, it specifies the tenant name. The name must be 2–20 characters long, consist of letters, digits, and underscores (\_), be case-sensitive, start with a letter or an underscore, and not be the reserved word sys.
